articles.summary: Power densities in modern AI accelerators and HPC devices now routinely exceed 1 W/mm². articles.summary: A smartphone’s design can genuinely make or break whether I want to use it. I know, I know, you should never judge a book by its cover, but a phone is different. It’s something I’m going to look at every single day, probably hundreds of times, so yes, looks matter to me. But there’s another side to that. I also don’t want to keep buying and using what feels like the same phone over and over again, and that’s increasingly how I’ve felt about Samsung. I’ve been using its phones, especially the Ultra models , for the past four or five years, and while Samsung has refined the formula with each generation, the overall design has barely advanced.

articles.summary: Ox-alpha, the stealth model that quickly became the most popular model on OpenRouter in the last few days, is actually Z.ai’s GLM-5.3-Flash, a 320 billion-parameter hybrid model (with 18 billion active parameters) that the team specifically trained for ultra-low-cost inference. articles.summary:
英國一座小型發電設施今年7月遭到網路攻擊，設施因此停擺4天。英國政府確認這起事故影響小型能源發電設施，但沒有危及整體能源系統；攻擊者身分目前尚未獲官方確認，不過英國媒體報導指出，事件疑似與伊朗相關駭客有關。
根據每日電訊報最先揭露的消息，基於安全考量，英國官員沒有公布受害設施名稱及所在地。這起事故已通報英國國家網路安全中心（National Cyber Security Centre，NCSC），但NCSC目前並未公開事故技術細節。
